posts.text: Unit 42: an AI-run attacker took password hashes and MFA secrets at a European government body in two hours. First vendor account of a successful PHP2Shell intrusion; victim unnamed, data source unstated, domain-admin outcome not given.
posts.note: The outlet gets the link; the card carries our framing.

posts.text: PHP2Shell, day four, evening: nothing new. Still no organization confirmed breached by name; CISA's exploited-vulnerabilities catalog, opened directly, still has no PHP entry; no PHP release since Oct 21.
posts.note: From "Since the last refresh"; written to be posted as-is.

posts.text: New to the index: Straiker says the criminal group CyberCartel ran Claude- and Grok-driven agents against more than 400 Latin American banks and fintechs. Its stolen database held 4,493 records, among them 903 account numbers and 67 cleartext passwords.
posts.note: From "Since the last refresh"; written to be posted as-is.

posts.text: Also new: Reuters established that one Chinese-speaking hacker's AI agents, run through the open-source Cairn platform, broke into websites of more than 100 companies, Deere, SharkNinja and Cummins among them, at about $50 a hack.
posts.note: From "Since the last refresh"; written to be posted as-is.

posts.text: Johns Hopkins Bayview is telling 3,182 patients that a worker uploaded their names, treatment dates, medications and record numbers to a public AI tool the hospital had not approved. Discovered Sept 21, letters out Oct 22, tool unnamed.
posts.note: From "Since the last refresh"; written to be posted as-is.
